policy: Every failed production/news workflow must have an incident entry. A detected failure may be recorded with rootCauseStatus=pending, but may only be marked resolved after confirmed cause, merged regression, passing CI and successful equivalent live run.

incidents.symptom: Official RSS metadata intake succeeded (6/6 feeds, 13 candidates) but the primary-source extraction step stopped immediately with SyntaxError; downstream triage and Japanese brief were skipped.
incidents.observedError: SyntaxError: Identifier 'bySource' has already been declared
incidents.directCause: scripts/check-news-primary-pages.mjs declared const bySource twice at module scope: first as a publisher lookup Map and later as a diagnostic summary Array.
incidents.systemicCause: The previous change passed unit tests and Next.js build because the standalone news intake CLI was not parsed or executed by the Verify pipeline; checks covered its imported helpers but not the actual entrypoint.
incidents.impact: 13 candidates were captured as an RSS-only artifact; official page verification, editorial triage, and briefing did not run. No article was approved or published.
correctiveActions: Rename the diagnostic summary local to sourceBreakdown while preserving JSON field summary.bySource.
Run node --check on all production news and release CLIs as part of the default npm test.
Execute the real primary-source CLI in an isolated, zero-candidate, no-network smoke test.
Run a dedicated syntax gate before the scheduled news intake makes any network calls.

validation.evidence: Actual 2026-10-19 09:14 JST scheduled (event=schedule) intake on main 7a3447e passed: syntax gate, 6/6 official RSS feeds, 4 nonempty pending candidates, primary-page evidence stage retrieved 1/4, triage and Japanese editorial brief generated, four private artifacts uploaded. Original CLI SyntaxError did not recur. Separate unresolved primary-page coverage: html-too-large=2, http-403=1; this closure addresses the previously broken CLI pipeline, NOT full page retrieval or claim verification.

incidents.repeatSignature: SyntaxError: Identifier 'bySource' has already been declared

incidents.symptom: CI Verify Test failed after updating an incident from fix-in-review to monitoring; Lint and Build were skipped. A following CI attempt also failed because severity=low was incorrectly rejected by a generic minimum-text-length assertion.
incidents.directCause: The ledger lifecycle state was changed to monitoring after prior CI passed, but its unit test still hard-coded fix-in-review. The next revision also applied a >3 character assertion to severity, incorrectly excluding the valid enum value 'low'.
incidents.systemicCause: The regression test asserted one mutable administrative status rather than the actual safety invariant: an incident cannot be resolved without the required proof. Generic field-length validation was substituted for schema-aware validation of enumerated values.
incidents.impact: A PR-only CI failure; no scheduled workflow, live news collection, publication queue or Production delivery was changed by this failed test run.
correctiveActions: Replace the hard-coded mutable status assertion with lifecycle invariants tied to verification evidence.
Allow an explicitly documented production validation exemption for truly CI-only incidents, never for live intake or publication failures.
Require confirmed root cause and successful CI before closing a CI-only incident.
Validate severity against its explicit enum values instead of a generic minimum-string-length assertion.

validation.nonApplicableReason: The failed check is a test assertion about a JSON incident status, not a Production workflow or content change.
validation.evidence: CI Verify Test/Lint/Build successful on the PR with schema-specific severity and invariant-based status validation. Incident is CI-only; no production re-run is relevant.

incidents.repeatSignature: AssertionError: hardcoded mutable incident status mismatches ledger lifecycle

incidents.symptom: The NEWS-0096 owner-approved publication PR was rejected by the duplicate-drafting gate before Tests could run, because the previous Draft PR #212 remained open.
incidents.observedError: ARTICLE GATE BLOCKED: Duplicate drafting blocked: content/articles/openai-prompt-to-voice.md: NEWS-0096: PR history suggests prior work
incidents.directCause: checkReuseProvenance checked earlier unmerged PR history for all new articles; the approved manual release of the same work had no recognized release-specific provenance path.
incidents.systemicCause: The duplicate-drafting safety gate had tests for fresh-draft rejection and branch reuse, but none for a legitimate editor- and owner-approved article promoted from an existing review PR with immutable manuscript and image signatures.
incidents.impact: PR-only block; no unauthorized main changes or production article publication. Approval and media checks remained intact.
correctiveActions: Added provenOwnerNewsRelease to production start gate to require explicit historic owner approval and exact verified ready manuscript Git blob, approved copy text and WebP SHA before exempting a news release.
Kept normal duplicate drafting rejection for all drafts without complete owner-approved signed release provenance.
Confirmed release path passes actual GitHub PR article:ci as well as Test/Lint/Build.

validation.nonApplicableReason: This defect affects the PR duplicate-drafting gate only; the gate's correct release exception was verified in the actual GitHub CI PR run, not a live production collector.
validation.evidence: PR #214 verify run #39179262309: OWNER-APPROVED-NEWS-RELEASE: SHA-verified article and image; all Test/Lint/Build successful. Merged main Verify #39179409422 and Cloudflare Pages checks completed successfully.

incidents.repeatSignature: ARTICLE GATE BLOCKED: prior news review PR misidentified as unauthorized duplicate release

incidents.symptom: Following corrected editorial approval provenance, synthetic two-slot news integration failed on the expected second release of a day.
incidents.observedError: tests/news-two-slot-integration.test.ts line 134: AssertionError false !== true; expected synthetic evening release.
incidents.directCause: The synthetic fixture used 2026-10-19 as its test day, which now coincided with NEWS-0096's real published-on date; the historical log consumed one of the two allowed daily slots, causing the synthetic second story to be blocked correctly.
incidents.systemicCause: The fixture reused the repository's actual historical publication ledger and a fixed calendar day, without isolating its test dates from future real production releases.
incidents.impact: Only PR CI test failure. The two-news-per-day safety quota correctly prevented a third simulated release; no real news publication was involved.
correctiveActions: Moved synthetic tests to 2026-10-21, with 2026-10-20 as their prior day, avoiding collisions with historic manual releases.
Retained the genuine 2/day production quota; did not weaken it.
Require future integration tests to avoid fixed historical live-published dates and check whether their fixture day is independent of the current historic ledger.

validation.nonApplicableReason: A synthetic fixture collision cannot be replayed in Production; the correct quota behavior and adjusted isolated fixture were verified by GitHub CI.
validation.evidence: PR #214 verify run #39179262309 and merged main run #39179409422 passed after fixture separation.

incidents.repeatSignature: news two-slot integration fixture collides with real published news on fixed synthetic date

incidents.symptom: Editorial PR #204's first NEWS-0094 importance-first revision failed Test with manuscript 503 code points against the 350–500 editorial limit. Lint and Build skipped.
incidents.directCause: The editorial preflight counted only the story body before the trailing importance-scale disclaimer (457 code points), while the real test counted everything between the proposal header and sources heading, including the importance score and disclaimer: 503 total.
incidents.systemicCause: The author's pre-commit character-count check was not performed using the exact range defined by tests/news-editorial-proposals.test.ts; including metadata/disclaimer pushed the proposal just beyond the hard gate.
incidents.impact: Draft-review CI only. NEWS-0094 remained outside the public article registry, approval queue, and production news; no data loss, unauthorized publication, or change to NEWS-0096.
correctiveActions: Shortened the NEWS-0094 proposal to 494 code points using the same exact slice as the production editorial test, retaining the importance-first conclusion and all safety caveats.
Read back the GitHub branch file and counted the full test-defined source interval before the final commit; kept the strict 350–500 check unchanged.
Confirmed subsequent PR #204 Verify Test/Lint/Build pass without moving this unapproved story into any public release queue.

validation.nonApplicableReason: This failure was a 503-character editorial-proposal assertion in a review-only PR; it did not run or change any production collector, publication, or Cloudflare delivery.
validation.evidence: PR #204 follow-up commit 49f1732f87944bbbb8f870319956d5961f3ec762 passes actual GitHub Verify Test/Lint/Build, including editorial text-length gate. The news remains owner-unapproved and unpublished.

incidents.repeatSignature: NEWS-0094: proposal body exceeds test-defined 500 code-point cap after score or footnote

incidents.symptom: NEWS-0094 owner-approved ready news PR #219 failed at the duplicate-drafting gate because the historical editorial PR #204 was still open, despite the current article being owner approved and scheduled rather than a fresh draft.
incidents.observedError: ARTICLE GATE BLOCKED: Duplicate drafting blocked: content/articles/on-device-scam-detection.md: NEWS-0094: PR history suggests prior work; investigate before starting
incidents.directCause: The NEWS-0096 duplicate-drafting exemption recognized status=published manual releases with an immutable manual ledger and base64 image, but not status=ready, owner-approved news bound to a validated future queue record and local image source.
incidents.systemicCause: The prior CI-only fix (AI-NEWS-INC-20261019-003) covered one manual published path only; the authorized queued-ready news promotion path lacked a dedicated provenance exemption and regression test. Incremental branch commits triggered transient Verify failures before approval records, Registry, archive and CI gate changes were all present.
incidents.impact: Review PR-only Verify failures; NEWS-0094 remained unpublished and outside main, NEWS-0096 approved article and media unchanged, no unauthorized publication or Production changes.
correctiveActions: Added only a NEWS-0094-specific queued owner-release provenance check to the article start gate: requires immutable ready article Git Blob, exact approved copy, source SVG Blob, approved image SHA, official primary URL, exact 2026-10-19 18:00 JST slot and owner consent text.
Kept the general duplicate-drafting rejection for all unapproved drafts. The 18:00 publisher still verifies actual WebP bytes, SHA, article, CTA, time and two-post-per-day quota.
Verified real PR #219 GitHub article start gate, Test/Lint/Build and standalone media preparation pass for the staged owner-approved story; no CI bypass for a less-complete record.
Retained test coverage for both prepublication ready and postpublication published states to avoid a fixture-state collision with live release.

validation.nonApplicableReason: Duplicate drafting gate executes only for pull request CI; the failure and narrow approved-queue exception were reverified in GitHub PR Verify and cannot be reproduced as a Production news publication without changing its state.
validation.evidence: PR #219 Validate/gate and Test/Lint/Build passed after the narrow queued-ready exception. Actual 18:00 JST publication is separately not yet verified and cannot be claimed here.

incidents.repeatSignature: ARTICLE GATE BLOCKED: prior news review PR treated authorized owner-approved release as duplicate fresh draft
